name: cloud_cover_label
description: §22's UI half of PR #118's own checklist gap: the "- N% cloudy" weather-panel suffix (CloudCoverLabelKey = "cloud_cover_label") never got its own live A/B, only cloud_cover.json's sky tint did. Reuses cloud_cover.json's fixture exactly -- latitude 45, day 40, hour 16 -- because that scenario already surveyed hour 16 as the drift peak (0.2710) under this tile/season, and Patch_CloudCoverLabel reads the same CloudCoverClock.FractionForMap the sky patch does, so the peak hour is peak for both. Master cloud_cover stays ON throughout both captures (Patch_CloudCoverLabel early-returns if the master is off, per CelestialLightingFeatures' own note on CloudCoverLabel being a sub-toggle of CloudCover, same relationship as AuroraCurtain to Aurora) -- only cloud_cover_label toggles, so the pair isolates the text suffix from the sky-tint change cloud_cover.json already measured. No Screenshot step in this harness supports a crop/region arg (Shared/Steps/BuiltIn/VerificationSteps.cs's ScreenshotStep takes only fileName), so these are full 1920x1080 captures like cc_off.png/cc_on.png; the label sits in GlobalControls' fixed 230px-wide weather Rect at the screen's top-right, so ΔE for this pair should be measured over that cropped region, not the full frame -- a full-frame ΔE for a small UI-text change would read as far weaker than the widget itself shows.
